dialogues.title: Leaving a message
dialogues.context: Bir şirketi arıyorsun ama görüşmek istediğin kişi müsait değil.

lines.en: Good morning, Meridian Design. How can I help?
lines.tr: Günaydın, Meridian Design. Nasıl yardımcı olabilirim?
alternatives: Meridian Design, good morning.

lines.en: Hi, this is Baris. Can I speak to Ms. Yilmaz, please?
lines.tr: Merhaba, ben Barış. Bayan Yılmaz'la görüşebilir miyim?
alternatives: Hello, my name is Baris — is Ms. Yilmaz available?

lines.en: One moment. Who's calling, please?
alternatives: May I ask what it's regarding?

lines.en: Baris Kaya. I'm calling about the contract.
alternatives: It's Baris Kaya — about the contract we discussed.

lines.en: Thank you. Hold on a second.
alternatives: Thanks — please hold.

lines.en: Sorry to keep you waiting. She's not available right now.
lines.tr: Beklettiğim için özür dilerim. Şu anda müsait değil.
alternatives: Apologies for the wait — she's in a meeting.

lines.en: Can I take a message?
alternatives: Would you like to leave a message?

lines.en: Could you ask her to call me back?
alternatives: Please ask her to give me a ring.

lines.en: Of course. What's the best number?
alternatives: Certainly — which number should she use?

lines.en: It's oh-seven-double-four, one-two-three, nine-nine-eight.
lines.tr: Sıfır yedi dört dört, bir iki üç, dokuz dokuz sekiz.
alternatives: I'll give you my mobile — 0744 123 998.

lines.en: Let me read that back to you.
alternatives: Just to confirm, that was...

lines.en: That's right. Thanks a lot.
alternatives: Perfect — thank you.

dialogues.title: A bad connection
dialogues.context: Arkadaşınla akşam planı yapıyorsun ama çekim kötü ve telefonun şarjı azalıyor.

lines.en: Hey! Are we still on for tonight?
lines.tr: Selam! Bu akşam için hâlâ geçerli mi?
alternatives: Hi — is tonight still happening?

lines.en: Sorry, you're breaking up.
alternatives: I can barely hear you — bad signal.

lines.en: Can you hear me now?
alternatives: Is that better?

lines.en: A bit better. Could you speak up a little?
lines.tr: Biraz daha iyi. Biraz yüksek sesle konuşabilir misin?
alternatives: Slightly — can you talk a bit louder?

lines.en: I said — are we still meeting at seven?
lines.tr: Diyorum ki, hâlâ yedide buluşuyor muyuz?
alternatives: Seven o'clock — still good?

lines.en: Sounds good to me. Same place?
alternatives: That works. Usual spot?

lines.en: Yeah, the place across from the bank.
alternatives: Same as always — opposite the bank.

lines.en: Sorry, I didn't catch that. One more time?
alternatives: Say that again? The line's terrible.

lines.en: The café across from the bank!
alternatives: Café. Opposite. The bank!

lines.en: Got it. My battery's about to die.
alternatives: Understood — I'm nearly out of battery.

lines.en: No worries, just text me if anything changes.
lines.tr: Sorun değil, bir şey değişirse mesaj at.
alternatives: That's fine — message me if it changes.

lines.en: Will do. Talk to you soon!
alternatives: I will. See you at seven!

dialogues.title: Calling about an apartment
dialogues.context: İnternette gördüğün kiralık daire ilanı için arıyorsun. Ayrıntıları öğrenip randevu alacaksın.

lines.en: Hello?
alternatives: Hello, who's this?

lines.en: Hi, I'm calling about the ad for the apartment.
alternatives: Hello — is the flat still available?

lines.en: Yes, it's still available. Is this a good time?
lines.tr: Evet, hâlâ müsait. Şu an müsait misiniz?
alternatives: It is. Can you talk now?

lines.en: Yes, go ahead. Is the rent negotiable?
lines.tr: Evet, buyurun. Kirada pazarlık payı var mı?
alternatives: Sure. Can you tell me about the rent?

lines.en: It's eight hundred, bills not included.
alternatives: Eight hundred a month, plus bills.

lines.en: Sorry, I didn't catch that — how much?
alternatives: Could you say that again?

lines.en: Eight hundred. Bills are extra.
alternatives: Eight-zero-zero, and bills on top.

lines.en: That's a bit out of my price range, honestly.
alternatives: That's more than I was hoping to pay.

lines.en: I could do seven-fifty for a long lease.
lines.tr: Uzun süreli sözleşmede yedi yüz elli yapabilirim.
alternatives: For a two-year contract, seven fifty.

lines.en: That works for me. Could I see it this week?
lines.tr: Bana uyar. Bu hafta görebilir miyim?
alternatives: I could do that. When can I view it?

lines.en: How about Thursday at six?
alternatives: Thursday evening suit you?

lines.en: Thursday works. I'll send you an email to confirm.
lines.tr: Perşembe uygun. Teyit için size e-posta atacağım.
alternatives: Perfect — I'll confirm by text.

lines.en: Great. See you then.
alternatives: Lovely — see you Thursday.
